Secret.

In reply, state NUMBER and DATE.

QK/1163, dated 14.7.41.

I.5. (Capt, Cecil Liddell)

Reference your P.F.41426/B.9a of 28.5.41:

We have received a report dated 5th July, 1941, stating that Niall Verschoyle GOULD is at present interned. He formerly resided at 9, Lower Stephen Street, Dublin.

NO ACTION TO BE TAKEN WITHOUT REFERENCE TO B.I.H.

K Harcher

for V.V.

ENCL

15 JUL 1941

TO B9K/B4a2

REF
